Name: Grains Overhull
Author: slimerrain
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MIrE9Ve.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Adds 6 new Grain crops, including gluten-free ones! 
[*]Renames "Unmilled Rice" to "Brown Rice" and "Rice" to "White Rice"
[*]Adds 5 new Cooking ingredients.
[*]Adds 8 new Cooking recipes and 1 more Food item. Maybe Gus knows a thing or two about them?
 [/list][list]
[*]NPCs will react to these new items according to their own tastes when gifted.
[*]Config allows disabling of any of the crops incase another mod adds the exact same one. (Through the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.)
 [/list][list]
[*]1.5.6 version only adds the crops- If enough people say they would like updates for it I will add the rest of the content.
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/jOqzing.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aMT3Jv6.png[/img]

[b]Barley[/b]: spring, 4 days to mature
[b]Buckwheat[/b]: spring/summer, 5 days to mature
[b]Millet[/b]: summer, 4 days to mature
[b]Oat[/b]: spring, 4 days to mature
[b]Rye[/b]: summer/fall, 6 days to mature
[b]Sorghum[/b]: summer/fall, 5 days to mature

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DEf8EXe.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zcGSYBK.png[/img]

﻿In order of the image: Pearl Barley, Buckwheat Flour, Hulled Millet, Rolled Oats, Rye Flour.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/11cMxYP.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VYDj2NC.png[/img]

[b]Harvest Bowl[/b]: +168 energy, +75 health, +2 farming, +1 foraging, +1 speed, 9:20; brown rice + cranberry sauce [cranberries + sugar] + kale + yam
[b]Overnight Oats[/b]: +38 energy, +17 health, +1 speed, +1 defense, +1 attack, 14:00; made via 1 oat in a preserve jar
[b]Blueberry Oatmeal[/b]: +58 energy, +26 health, +2 defense, 9:20; blueberry + maple syrup + milk (any) + 2 rolled oats
[b]Rye Bread[/b]: +30 energy, +13 health, +1 luck, +1 magnetism, 7:00; rye flour + wheat flour
[b]Trail Mix[/b]: +200 energy, +90 health; dried fruit + oat + pearl barley + wheat
[b]Galette[/b]: +130 energy, +58 health, +2 defense, 9:20; buckwheat flour + cheese + egg (any) + oil
[b]Millet Porridge[/b]: +38 energy, +17 health, +50 max energy, 7:00; hulled millet
[b]Buckwheat Waffles[/b]: +168 energy, +75 health, +2 luck, +2 defense, 9:20; buckwheat flour + egg (any) + maple syrup + milk (any)
[b]Sorghum Salad[/b]: +85 energy, +38 health, +2 mining, +1 luck, 7:00; cranberries + ginger + sorghum

[Note: Overnight Oats are made through Preserves Jar rather than in the kitchen.]﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/oZda0iw.png[/img]

To install and use the Grains Overhull mod, do the following:
  
1. Prerequisites:[list]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore [/url]﻿(Optional)
[*] ﻿Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ (Optional)
[/list]
2. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20884?tab=files]Grains Overhull[/url] 

3. ﻿Extract the following folders from the downloaded zip file into your Mods folder:[list][*] ﻿[CP] Grains Overhull
[/list]
[To Uninstall, remove any of the 6 crops from the field, trash any of the items and seeds in your inventory, and then delete the two mod folders extracted into the Mods folder.]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rXBP4ec.png[/img]
